steps.en: Failed sends are retried and then flagged
steps.id: Pengiriman gagal dicoba ulang lalu ditandai
steps.why_en: Only one retry round runs per day, and the whole schedule is switched off in the settings.
steps.why_id: Hanya satu putaran retry per hari, dan seluruh jadwalnya dimatikan di pengaturan.
